fields.Name: T1p -> S-T.3
fields.Description: Gate G2.20 (phase 2, dataset T1p, criterion S-T.3): at every origin the seasonal-naïve MASE equals the value computed independently from the planted series and that origin's training window, within 1e-9, 100% of origins. It fails when seasonal naïve reads the whole series instead of the origin's training window (mismatches > 0).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Every origin's seasonal-naive MASE and MASE scale equal the independent values from that origin's training window within 1e-9, 100% of origins (1 of 1 pytest case passes).
